summary: Voyager Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce FDA clearance of its IND application for VY1706, a tau-silencing gene therapy for Alzheimer's disease. The company plans a multi-site open-label dose-escalation trial beginning in H2 2026, enrolling up to 18 early-AD patients. No pricing, merger, acquisition, or restructuring terms are present; the filing is a routine clinical milestone update. This is not a special-situation event.
